annotations.title: Federal AI Governance, OMB M-24-10/M-24-18 & NIST AI RMF 1.0 Compliance Package

description: Evaluate AI/ML/LLM solutions proposed for federal and SLED agencies against OMB Memoranda M-24-10 & M-24-18, NIST AI RMF 1.0 (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage), and DoD Responsible AI (RAI) Toolkit, outputting a Safety-Impact Classification & Model Card. Returns a strictly validated `AiGovernanceOmbResponse` JSON object containing `omb_safety_and_rights_impact_overview`, `nist_ai_rmf_govern_map_measure_manage_matrix`, `omb_m_24_10_and_m_24_18_minimum_practices_audit`, and `federal_ai_system_card_and_hitl_safeguards` grounded in OMB Memorandum M-24-10, OMB Memorandum M-24-18 (Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of AI in Government), NIST AI 100-1 (AI RMF 1.0), NIST AI 600-1, & DoD CDAO RAI Shield. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive GovCon compliance and capture analysis call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key or X-SignalTender-Key; `proposed_ai_system_and_agency_use_case_text` accepts 15 to 45,000 characters, while `target_ai_governance_frameworks` and `deployment_enclave_and_training_data_policy` calibrate the regulatory regime and threshold assumptions). Use this tool when executing Federal AI Governance, OMB M-24-10/M-24-18 & NIST AI RMF 1.0 Compliance Package workflows; use `scan_far_dfars_clauses` instead for general FAR/DFARS clause flow-down audits, or `generate_compliance_matrix` for general Section L/M 'shall' requirement extraction.

deployment_enclave_and_training_data_pol.default: Stateless RAG on Agency Tenant (Zero Training on Government CUI/PII; Open-Format Export to Prevent Vendor Lock-In)
deployment_enclave_and_training_data_pol.description: Operational context, threshold parameters, or compliance posture assumptions (defaults to 'Stateless RAG on Agency Tenant (Zero Training on Government CUI/PII; Open-Format Export to Prevent Vendor Lock-In)').

proposed_ai_system_and_agency_use_case_t.description: Primary solicitation text, clause excerpts, deliverable schedule, or technical/financial context for Federal AI Governance, OMB M-24-10/M-24-18 & NIST AI RMF 1.0 Compliance Package (15 to 45,000 characters).

target_ai_governance_frameworks.description: Target regulatory regime, statutory authority, or evaluation framework (defaults to 'OMB_M_24_10_OMB_M_24_18_NIST_AI_RMF_1_0_NIST_AI_600_1_GenAI_And_DoD_CDAO_RAI_Toolkit').

name: generate_ai_governance_nist_ai_rmf_omb_m24

federal_ai_system_card_and_hitl_safeguar.description: Statutory governance protocol and actionable submission verification checklist.

nist_ai_rmf_govern_map_measure_manage_ma.description: Structured line-by-line regulatory audit, classification, or quantitative schedule rows.

omb_m_24_10_and_m_24_18_minimum_practice.description: Paste-ready compliance narratives, control specifications, or submission sections.

omb_safety_and_rights_impact_overview.description: Executive determination overview, regulatory citations, and readiness score.
